description: Physics-lumped MSF brine-recirculation (MSF-BR) model: stage-by-stage mass & energy balance with flashing, non-equilibrium allowance (NEA), brine-heater steam consumption, GOR / performance ratio, and a lumped stage-temperature transient ODE.

unit.name: Generic MSF-BR desalination plant (24-stage recovery section)
unit.source: El-Dessouky, H.T. & Ettouney, H.M. (2002) Fundamentals of Salt Water Desalination, Elsevier, Ch. 7 (MSF).

T_top_brine_C.note: Top brine temperature leaving brine heater (TBT)

T_steam_C.note: Heating steam saturation temperature in brine heater (TBT + terminal diff)

M_recirc_kg_s.note: Recirculating brine mass flow through the stages

salinity_feed_ppm.note: Recirculating brine feed salinity (Gulf seawater ~ 42000 ppm)

cp_brine_kJ_kgK.source: El-Dessouky & Ettouney (2002) seawater cp ~ 3.9-4.0 at 40-110 C

hfg_kJ_kg.source: El-Dessouky & Ettouney (2002); IAPWS at ~75 C mean stage temp
hfg_kJ_kg.note: Mean latent heat of vaporisation across stages

hfg_steam_kJ_kg.note: Latent heat of heating steam in brine heater

NEA_coeff.note: Non-equilibrium allowance scaling factor (El-Dessouky & Ettouney 2002 Eq. 7). NEA per stage ~ deltaT_stage * coeff (degC), typically 0.2-0.8 degC; reduces effective flash range.

tau_stage_s.source: Estimated from stage brine holdup / flow
tau_stage_s.note: Lumped thermal time constant of a stage (residence time of brine)

U_heater_kW_m2K.source: El-Dessouky & Ettouney (2002) typical MSF overall U

T_top_brine_C.note: Above ~120 C CaSO4 scaling becomes severe
